description: Semantic mapping of M8 tracker views: defines the structure of each grid view so cursor position + line text can be interpreted as typed field values.

notes.fontMode: All x/width values assume font mode 0 (standard, 12×14 px cells, 40 cols × ~22 rows). Font modes 1 (bold uppercase) and 2 (large) may shift column positions.
notes.playbackIndicator: The M8 renders a '>' character one column to the left of the first data column when that step/row/track is currently playing. This character is part of the text stream; the editing cursor is a separate rect overlay.
notes.emptyCell: An empty or unused cell displays '--' (2 chars) or '---' (3 chars) or '---00' (command+value). Parsed hexValue will be null for these.
notes.relativeHex: Transpose and some FX values use relative hex: 00 = no change, 01-7F = +1-127, FF-80 = -1-128. See 'Relative and Absolute FX Commands' in the manual.
notes.rowIndex: Row/step indices are parsed from the leftmost characters of currentLine. They are hex for all grid views.

fieldTypes.chainRef: Reference to a chain number (hex 00-FF). '--' means empty/unused.
fieldTypes.phraseRef: Reference to a phrase number (hex 00-FF). '--' means empty/unused.
fieldTypes.note: Musical note in M8 format: [A-G][#|-][0-9] e.g. 'C-4', 'A#3'. '---' = empty. 'OFF' = note-off.
fieldTypes.instrumentRef: Instrument number 00-7F (hex). '--' = no retrigger (keep current instrument).
fieldTypes.fxCommand: 3-character sequencer or instrument FX command name, e.g. 'KIL', 'ARP', 'DEL'. '---' = none.
fieldTypes.fxValue: 2-char hex value 00-FF accompanying an FX command. Interpretation depends on the command.
fieldTypes.transpose: Semitone or tick transpose. Relative: 00=none, 01-7F=+1-+127, FF-80=-1--128.
fieldTypes.ticks: Number of ticks this step consumes in a groove (hex 01-FF). '00' skips the step. '--' = empty (groove loops at this point).
fieldTypes.volume: Volume multiplier 00-FF (hex). Multiplied with the phrase-row velocity. '--' = no override.
fieldTypes.ppq: Pulses Per Quarter note: resolution of the groove clock (decimal). Only editable on groove row 0.
fieldTypes.instrumentName: Instrument name string (up to 12 characters). Text field, no hex value.
fieldTypes.eqSlot: EQ slot assignment (hex). '--' = no EQ applied to this instrument.
fieldTypes.rowIndex: The positional index of this row in the current view (song row, chain position, phrase step, etc.).

song.title: Song View
song.description: Arranges chains across 8 independent tracks to form the song structure. Each row is a song position; each column is a track.

rowField.description: Song row 00-FF. Each track loops back to row 00 when it reaches '--'.

chain.title: Chain View
chain.description: An ordered list of up to 16 phrases. The first '--' phrase ends the chain and loops back to the song.

rowField.description: Position within the chain (0-F, max 16 entries).

columns.label: Phrase (PH)
columns.description: Phrase number to play at this chain position.

columns.label: Transpose (TSP)
columns.description: Optional note transpose in semitones applied to every note in the phrase (relative hex).

phrase.title: Phrase View
phrase.description: A 16-step sequence. Each step holds a note, velocity, instrument assignment, and up to 3 FX command+value pairs.

rowField.description: Step index 0-F (16th note by default; altered by groove).

table.title: Table View
table.description: A 16-step mini-sequencer that runs alongside an instrument. Used for arpeggios, multi-stage envelopes, and automated FX.

rowField.description: Table step 0-F. Loops from bottom unless a HOP command redirects.

columns.label: Transpose (N)
columns.description: Transposes the instrument for this step (relative hex). '--' = no transpose.

columns.label: Volume (V)
columns.description: Volume multiplier applied on top of the phrase velocity (hex). '--' = no override.

columns.label: FX1 Command
columns.description: 3-char command name for table FX slot 1.

columns.label: FX2 Command
columns.description: 3-char command name for table FX slot 2.

columns.label: FX3 Command
columns.description: 3-char command name for table FX slot 3.

groove.title: Groove View
groove.description: Defines the timing of each phrase step in ticks. Used to create swing, shuffle, triplets, and other rhythmic feels.

rowField.description: Groove step 0-F. The groove loops when a '--' entry is reached.

columns.label: Ticks (TIC)
columns.description: Number of ticks this step takes. Default is 06 (at 24 PPQN = 1 sixteenth note). '00' skips the step.

columns.label: PPQ
columns.description: Pulses Per Quarter note. Only present on groove row 0; absent on all other rows.

instrumentpool.title: Instrument Pool
instrumentpool.description: Lists all instrument slots with their mix routing. Each row shows the instrument name and its dry/FX send levels.

columns.label: Instrument Name
columns.description: Name of the instrument in this slot (up to 12 chars). '------------' = empty slot.

columns.label: Dry (DRY)
columns.description: Direct output volume for this instrument (hex 00-FF).

ARP.description: Arpeggio: plays 3 notes rapidly. X=first interval semitones, Y=second interval semitones.

ARC.description: Arpeggio Config: X=mode, Y=speed in ticks.

CHA.description: Chance: X=probability left of command (0=never, F=always), Y=probability right.

DEL.description: Delay: in phrase delays entire row by XX ticks; in table delays table playhead.

GRV.description: Groove: sets groove number XX for the current track.

GGR.description: Global Groove: sets groove XX for all tracks.

HOP.description: Hop: in phrase jumps to row Y of next phrase; HOPFF stops track. In table loops to row Y X times.

INS.description: Instrument: changes active instrument to XX as an FX command.

KIL.description: Kill: stops the playing instrument after XX ticks.

RND.description: Random: randomises the preceding FX command. X=left range, Y=right range (0=none, F=full).

RNL.description: Randomise Left: randomises the FX command to the left.

RET.description: Retrig: retriggers current row. Y≠0: retrig every Y ticks with X volume ramp. Y=0: single retrig after X ticks.

REP.description: Repeat: repeats and increments the last FX command by XX each step.

RTO.description: Repeat To: sets the min/max value that REP stops at.

RMX.description: Remix: repositions the phrase playhead (Y) on tracks to the left (selected by X).

NTH.description: Nth Trigger: conditional trigger based on loop count.

PSL.description: Pitch Slide (portamento): enables portamento for XX ticks.

PBN.description: Pitch Bend: continuous pitch slide up (00-7F) or down (80-FF).

PVX.description: Extreme Vibrato: like PVB but with higher range.

SCA.description: Track Scale: X=key signature, Y=scale number for this track.

SCG.description: Global Scale: X=key, Y=scale number for the whole song.

SNG.description: Song Hop: moves this track's song position by XX rows relative to current.

SED.description: Random Seed: sets the random seed XX for this track.

TBL.description: Table: assigns table number XX to the current instrument.

THO.description: Table Hop: jumps all table columns to position 0X.

TIC.description: Table Tick: sets the table tick rate. In a table, each FX column can run independently.

TBX.description: Aux Table: runs table XX in parallel with the instrument table. 00=stop aux table.

TPO.description: Tempo: sets song BPM to XX (hex → decimal conversion shown in help text).

TSP.description: Global Transpose: transposes the entire song by XX semitones.

NXT.description: Next Track Trigger: plays instrument XX on the next track using current note/velocity.

OFF.description: Note Off: stops the playing instrument after XX ticks. Triggers ADSR release stage.

MTT.description: Micro Time: adjusts row playback timing in sub-tick (1/8 tick) amounts.

FIN.description: Fine tune: pitch offset -1 to +1 semitones (relative).

VMV.description: Main Volume: sets the main song output volume.
